coordinate_hypothesis.confidence: Room arrangement and handedness owner-confirmed by sketch. Sizes are estimates in metres (±10–15 %); opening positions remain illustrative.
coordinate_hypothesis.axes: Match upright owner sketch: x increases LEFT to RIGHT; y increases TOP kitchen end to BOTTOM parking end. No geographic north inferred.
coordinate_hypothesis.unregistered_voids: No leftover interior voids: clear room rectangles tile the house with one wall between neighbours.
coordinate_hypothesis.important_layout_note: This is a new owner-sketch coordinate system, not old v2 coordinates. Kitchen spans full house width at top. Porch and exterior entry left of living near kitchen. Bedroom1 below living occupies left ~73%; corridor is right ~27%. Below bedroom1 en-suite left and commonWC right. Ensuite opens only from Bedroom2, commonWC opens into right corridor. Bedroom2 spans bottom full width and faces parking court. OutsideWC at upperleft, attached kitchen top-left corner; door faces down left-side passage. Gate in LEFT boundary beside bottom parking. Side and rear paths wrap house. Kitchen sink is left-wall window facing porch-side path; opposing large kitchen window right wall. No stairs.
coordinate_hypothesis.recommended_rendering: Default top-down plan orientation must exactly match owner sketch: kitchen TOP, parking BOTTOM, porch/gate LEFT, corridor RIGHT. Show each room's estimated size with its confidence and the not-a-survey note. Add sketch reference thumbnail. OutsideWC attached upper-left not detached. Roof-off single storey.
